title: About Pin2Pin Global
description: Mission, dataset scope, and engineering philosophy behind Pin2Pin Global — a datasheet-verified semiconductor pinout and cross-reference database for hardware engineers.

sections.heading: Why We Built Pin2Pin Global
paragraphs: Hardware engineers, PCB layout designers, and electronics sourcing teams lose hours every week opening multiple manufacturer PDF datasheets side by side to answer one deceptively dangerous question: can Component B safely replace Component A on an existing PCB?

Traditional distributor catalogs and datasheet aggregators return raw parametric filters or links to 40-page PDFs, but they rarely surface the physical and electrical traps that actually ruin prototypes — such as SOT-23-3 pinout reversals within the same product family, exposed thermal tabs tied to VOUT instead of GND on SOT-223-3 regulators, ceramic capacitor ESR oscillation on legacy 1117 LDOs, or identical SOIC-8 pinouts shared by push-pull op-amps and open-collector comparators.

Pin2Pin Global bridges that gap with a strictly structured, page-cited engineering cross-reference database. Every part profile, side-by-side comparison, and alternative hub is anchored to an exact, package-locked Orderable Part Number (OPN) verified directly against official manufacturer PDFs.

sections.heading: Phase 1 Engineering Scope (High-Density Analog & Power Pilot)
paragraphs: Rather than diluting accuracy across tens of thousands of unverified parts or 1,000-page multiplexed microcontrollers where pin-to-pin drop-in replacement rarely holds, Pin2Pin Global intentionally concentrates on <=24-pin analog, power management, and signal-chain devices where package footprints and electrical ratings govern drop-in feasibility.

Our English-language pilot baseline covers 50 high-demand, verified OPNs across three foundational categories, generating 85 canonically normalized 1:1 comparisons, 50 ranked alternative hubs, 3 interactive client-side engineering calculators, and 5 deep hardware failure-mode guides.
bullets: 25 Low-Dropout (LDO) Regulators spanning SOT-23-3, SOT-23-5, TSOT-23-5, and SOT-223-3 packages (fixed 3.3 V rails, ultra-low Iq battery rails, high-voltage 30 V inputs, and 1117-class thermal tabs).

15 Switching DC-DC Converters across synchronous and non-synchronous Boost, Buck, and Buck-Boost topologies (SOT-23-5, SOT-23-6, TSOT-23-6, SOT-563, SC-70-6, WSON-6, SOIC-8, VSON-10, VSON-14, and TO-263-5).

10 Operational Amplifiers & Comparators covering single SOT-23-5 and dual SOIC-8 packages, spanning legacy bipolar, JFET audio, low-voltage CMOS rail-to-rail, zero-drift chopper, and open-collector comparator architectures.

sections.heading: Core Engineering Principles
paragraphs: Every record published on pin2pin.dev adheres to five non-negotiable engineering and compliance standards designed to keep signal-to-noise high and hallucination risk near zero.
bullets: Package-Locked OPN Identity: We never mix multiple packages or pinouts inside a single part record. Every comparison evaluates exact orderable part numbers with verified Top/Bottom view orientation and exposed pad electrical nets.

Official Manufacturer Sources Only: Specifications and pinouts are extracted solely from official semiconductor manufacturer datasheets (such as Texas Instruments, Diodes Incorporated, onsemi, and Advanced Monolithic Systems). We never scrape distributor catalogs or re-host copyrighted PDFs.

Dual-Path Text + 300 DPI Vision Verification: Text parsers frequently misread multi-column tables and vector pinout diagrams. Every published part undergoes independent 300 DPI PNG visual verification of its pinout and key rating tables.

Conservative Three-Tier Compatibility Verdicts: We never issue blanket drop-in guarantees. Parts are deterministically classified into Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required, or Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required with explicit swap risks.
Client-Side Privacy & Practical Tools: Our LDO thermal margin, DC-DC inductor ripple, and Op-Amp GBWP/slew-rate calculators run 100% locally in your browser with zero server uploads.

sections.heading: Editorial Independence & Sustainability
paragraphs: Pin2Pin Global is an independent engineering reference resource. Component rankings, compatibility levels, and parameter winner matrices are computed purely by deterministic physical rules and verified datasheet specifications — manufacturers and distributors cannot pay to alter a part's compatibility tier or score.

To keep all cross-reference tables, SVG pinout diff viewers, and engineering calculators free to use, the site is supported by clearly separated display advertising (activated only after custom-domain compliance review) and contextual affiliate links to bench test equipment, SMD capacitor/inductor sample books, and prototyping adapters. Outbound links to DigiKey, Mouser, and LCSC are standard search deeplinks provided solely for engineer convenience without automated price scraping.
